mapper.select: SELECT medication_id AS item_seq, item_name, entp_name, material_name, class_name, etc_otc_code, efficacy, usage_dosage, edi_code, is_discontinued, TO_CHAR(updated_at, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS updated_at FROM medications WHERE medication_id = #{itemSeq}

SELECT medication_id AS item_seq, item_name, entp_name FROM medications WHERE INSTR(LOWER(REGEXP_REPLACE(item_name, '[[:space:]]', '')), #{keyword}) > 0 ORDER BY CASE WHEN LOWER(REGEXP_REPLACE(item_name, '[[:space:]]', '')) = #{keyword} THEN 0 WHEN INSTR(LOWER(REGEXP_REPLACE(item_name, '[[:space:]]', '')), #{keyword}) = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 2 END, item_name, medication_id OFFSET #{offset} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{limit} ROWS ONLY
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM medications WHERE INSTR(LOWER(REGEXP_REPLACE(item_name, '[[:space:]]', '')), #{keyword}) > 0
